//: The second gallery: widgets bound to expressions, effects that are run, a popup, a preference and a slot. The gallery opens it with F2 and hands it the active character as `who`. Its context is the ordinary one, so it may read only what the party knows; `who` is declared `any` so that the screen loads whatever the game's characters are made of.
title: Bindings, effects and slots

rows.text: <title>Bindings, effects and slots</>  A grid of {app.size[0]} by {app.size[1]}. Esc goes back.

bar.label: Blood
bar.tip: bar: its value and its maximum are expressions over the character.

list.tip: list: its rows are a list from an expression, and `it` is the row.

cols.frame: Bound to the screen and to app

number.label: Level
number.tip: number: Left and Right step it, or type a number and press Enter.

choice.label: Theme
choice.tip: choice: bound to the `theme` preference. Changing it restyles every screen.

button.label: Pick a thing
button.tip: button: `pick` opens a picker and the rest of its effects run with the choice.

button.label: Quit
button.tip: button: `confirm` asks in a popup, and only on yes does the rest run.

tooltip.value: Nothing with a tip has the focus.
